button.name: action_open_radian_wizard
button.invisible: move_type != 'in_invoice' or state != 'posted' or country_code != 'CO' or not l10n_co_edi_cufe_cude_ref or l10n_co_is_support_document or l10n_co_radian_status in ('accepted', 'rejected')

button.name: action_query_dian_status
button.invisible: country_code != 'CO' or l10n_co_dian_status not in ('sent', 'error') or (not l10n_co_dian_zip_key and not l10n_co_edi_cufe_cude_ref)

group.name: radian_info_group
group.invisible: move_type != 'in_invoice' or country_code != 'CO' or not l10n_co_edi_cufe_cude_ref or l10n_co_is_support_document

field.name: l10n_co_discrepancy_response_code
field.invisible: move_type not in ('out_refund', 'in_refund') and not debit_origin_id

field.name: l10n_co_invoice_period_start
field.required: move_type in ('out_refund', 'in_refund') and not reversed_entry_id and country_code == 'CO'

field.name: l10n_co_invoice_period_end
field.required: move_type in ('out_refund', 'in_refund') and not reversed_entry_id and country_code == 'CO'
